method: Real public CLI and canonical network; isolated home; actual Windows file handle permits reads/writes but denies delete-sharing, then handle release and recovery. No production installation changed.
setup_observation: Initial SKILL.md was unchanged; selected a changed reference. The first ZIP export inherited CRLF conversion and was safely refused with exit 0. A separate candidate was exported with per-command core.autocrlf=false and its complete inventory matched canonical Git blobs before the fault run. No global Git settings changed.
